title: QUANTFORGE Strategy
description: Declarative trading strategy definition for the QUANTFORGE engine. A strategy names the symbols and timeframe it trades, a set of entry/exit condition objects (all conditions in a rule array are ANDed together), and a risk block. Strategies are stored as JSON (or YAML) files under /strategies and validated against this schema before loading.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the strategy's intent.

symbols.description: Market symbols this strategy trades, in exchange notation (e.g. "BTC/USDT").

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe in ccxt notation, e.g. "1m", "15m", "1h", "4h", "1d".

entry_rules.description: Conditions that must ALL be true on a candle to open a position (AND semantics).

exit_rules.description: Conditions that must ALL be true on a candle to close an open position (AND semantics). Stop-loss / take-profit from the risk block always apply in addition to these rules.

risk.description: Risk management parameters. Percentages are plain numbers, e.g. 2 means 2%.

stop_loss_pct.description: Hard stop-loss distance from entry price, in percent.

take_profit_pct.description: Take-profit distance from entry price, in percent.

max_position_pct.description: Maximum share of account equity allocated to a single position, in percent.

max_daily_loss_pct.description: Daily loss limit in percent of equity; the engine stops opening new positions for the day once breached.

pine_source.description: Optional raw Pine Script source for this strategy. Phase 1 only stores and validates this field; a future-phase AI translation layer converts Pine Script into the declarative rule schema above. It has no runtime effect in Phase 1.

condition.description: A single boolean condition evaluated per candle. The `type` field selects the condition kind.

indicatorSpec.description: Reference to a technical indicator series, computed by the indicator layer (backed by the `technicalindicators` npm package).

name.description: Indicator identifier. `volume` is the raw candle volume series.

source.description: Input series for the indicator (default "close"). E.g. use sma with source "volume" for a volume moving average.

field.description: For multi-valued indicators: which output line to use. macd -> macd|signal|histogram (default macd); bollinger -> upper|middle|lower (default middle).

comparisonTarget.description: Right-hand side of an indicator comparison: a constant value, another indicator, or a candle price field. Exactly one of value/indicator/price must be set.

indicator.description: Another indicator series, e.g. EMA(9) crosses above EMA(21).

price.description: A raw candle field, e.g. close > bollinger upper.

indicatorComparison.description: Compare an indicator series against a constant, a price field, or another indicator series. Cross operators look at the previous and current candle.

note.description: Free-text documentation for humans; ignored by the engine.

operator.description: Comparison operator. crosses_above/crosses_below fire only on the candle where the crossover happens.

candlestickPattern.description: True when the named candlestick pattern (from the `technicalindicators` pattern-recognition set) completes on the current candle. Detection is delegated to that package; QUANTFORGE does not hand-roll pattern logic.

note.description: Free-text documentation for humans; ignored by the engine.

pattern.description: Pattern function name exactly as exported by the `technicalindicators` package.

priceLevel.description: Breakout / breakdown against a price level: either the rolling N-bar high/low (excluding the current candle) as dynamic resistance/support, or a fixed price value.

note.description: Free-text documentation for humans; ignored by the engine.

direction.description: breaks_above: close crosses from at-or-below to above the level (resistance breakout). breaks_below: mirror for support breakdown.

level.description: Level definition: rolling highest high / lowest low over `lookback` prior bars, or a fixed `value`.

lookback.description: Number of prior bars for highest_high / lowest_low (required for those levels).

externalSignal.description: OPTIONAL, ADVISORY-ONLY (Phase 1): gate a rule on a named external signal feed, e.g. the trend-jack pipeline's trending-topic output (output/trends_*.json in this repo, where topics carry a Reddit-score-derived `score` and tracked keywords such as "crypto" and "stocks"). Phase 1 only validates the shape; no bridge/adapter reads live feeds yet. Until a future phase wires a signal provider, the engine treats this condition as neutral (always satisfied) and logs a warning.

note.description: Free-text documentation for humans; ignored by the engine.

keyword.description: Topic/keyword to match in the signal feed, e.g. "crypto".

symbol.description: Alternative to keyword: match the feed by trading symbol, e.g. "BTC".

min_score.description: Minimum normalized signal strength (0-10 scale) required for the condition to pass once a provider is wired.
